Context: 13. During training in lndia.-

22. Persons owning houses.Certificate to be furnished by an employee living in a house owned by him/his wife/ children/ father/ mother. Also admissible if he owns a house but lives in a rented house.Para. 7.2.1.
23. Sharing rent-free accommodation.HRA not admissible if an employee shares rent-free accommodation allotted to another Government servant. - Para. 5.1 (i).
